{{Short description|Portuguese-born novelist, journalist and educator (1960–2025)}}
[[File:Clara-Pinto-Correia.jpeg|thumb|right|Clara Pinto-Correia]]
'''Clara Pinto-Correia''' (30 January 1960 – 9 December 2025) was a Portuguese novelist, journalist and educator.

== Life and career ==
The daughter of a physician, she was born in [[Lisbon]] and earned a doctorate in cellular biology from the [[University of Porto]]. She was an adjunct professor in Veterinary and Animal Sciences at the [[University of Massachusetts Amherst]]. She wrote a weekly column for the Portuguese newspaper ''[[Diário de Notícias]]''.<ref name=who/>

In 1984, she published her first novel ''Watercress'' (''Agrião''), followed by ''Goodbye Princess'' (''Adeus, Princesa'') in 1985.<ref name=who>{{cite book |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=Y-TMhtk5AUYC&pg=PA72 |title=Who's who in Contemporary Women's Writing |page=72 |last=Miller |first=Jane Eldridge |year=2001 |ISBN=0415159806}}</ref> ''Adeus, Princesa'' was made into a movie in 1992.<ref>{{IMDb name|id=0684602 |name=Clara Pinto Correia}}</ref>

Pinto-Correia died on 9 December 2025, at the age of 65.<ref>[https://sapo.pt/artigo/escritora-clara-pinto-correia-morre-aos-65-anos-6938221c7b9e393f8b673d87 Escritora Clara Pinto Correia morre aos 65 anos] {{in lang|pt}}</ref>
